free_text: Given the patient has a prior negative biopsy and a new PI-RADS 4 lesion identified on MRI, the cohort criterion strongly supports proceeding with a repeat biopsy. This decision is further supported by the laboratory finding that the PSA density of 0.17 ng/mL/cc exceeds the EAU exclusion threshold. The evidence converged on the need for further tissue sampling to evaluate the high-risk lesion.
